Review: Title: Would be a great set if the brush didn’t smell of burnt rubber Review: At the current price of $14.99, this brush set comes with a large boar/nylon bristle brush with wooden handle and decorative floral design on back, a plastic comb,  and a plastic with metal tines brush rake for cleaning the hair from the brush.

This brush passed through my hair easily. The comb is a wide tooth plastic comb that is good for detangling hair in the shower. The rake is useless; I have yet to find one that works. What I absolutely hate is the smell of the brush. It STINKS of BURNT RUBBER. It is probably the finish on the handle, but the smell is extremely offensive to me. This is not a brush I will use, unfortunately due to the terrible smell. 

I aired out this set for hours and the smell did not wane.

The DOT can not be heard in the next room with a simple wall & full door opening. The microwave is louder. I can't count on it as an alarm, reminder to take my meds or anything else.

Review: Title: Hard to hold; odd holder that doesn’t stay put; brush bristles do detangle Review: This is a very odd brush. It is lightweight but the handle is so wide that I find it difficult to hold and brush with. The bristles do detangler but  without a good handle, it is a moot point to me. Also, the holder is round. Note that a round object does not stand up on its own. This does not stand up in the holder; instead it rolls over onto its side. The only way it will stand up is if I put the base of the round hold down and then  balance the brush in the other hole (see photo). It comes with an adhesive that fits on the bottom but it makes no sense to use this.

In summary, the entire brush is odd, the holder is non-functional, the handle is too thick on the brush to use comfortably, and the double-sided adhesive makes not sense to use. The current price of $16.90 is also way too expensive for this lightweight plastic brush ensemble.

Review: I have Echo's all throughout my house.  But, as a writer, I quickly learned that recently, distraction has now become the norm with Echo Show. So, I am no longer a fan because you see, I also have Google Nest in my home, and truth be told, they show my photo collection much sharper, the sound is better when playing music and I have found, much smarter when in need of information, and the best part... NO ADS! NO INTERRUPTIONS! NO TRYING TO SELL YOU ANYTHING. So you make your own choices, but Google also has a sense of humor and I am done with Echo Show...  Do you want to pay money to be inundated with Ads! Some every minute (see Jeopardy photos).  Amazon has lost all my respect as to how it respects its purchasers of their products!

Review: A couple of things..... This poncho arrived without ANY labels. No content... no washing directions... from CHINA.  The picture shows a much different color than what arrived.  It is NOT the ivory shown... it is a heathered brown with some ivory. Pics on the ad page are very misleading.  I have included pics I hope will be helpful to you.  It is small - "junior" sized.  I am 5'7"... 38DDD and usually wear a 14/16 or 0x/1x.  I did not expect this to be plus sized in any way, however, I really expected it to be a bit more "normal" in size. It is very loose knit - so it will snag if not super careful.  The buttons are cheesy looking plastic.  It feels like it is acrylic, however, with no labels of any kind, I really can't say.  I washed it on hand wash cycle and laid flat to dry just in case.  I will keep it because it was fairly inexpensive and the hassle of returning it would cost more than the sweater is worth both in terms of dollars and in terms of the hassle.  I would NOT order from this seller again.

Review: A couple of things..... This poncho arrived without ANY labels. No content... no washing directions... from CHINA.  The picture shows a much different color than what arrived.  It is NOT the ivory shown... it is a heathered brown with some ivory. Pics on the ad page are very misleading.  I have included pics I hope will be helpful to you.  It is small - "junior" sized.  I am 5'7"... 38DDD and usually wear a 14/16 or 0x/1x.  I did not expect this to be plus sized in any way, however, I really expected it to be a bit more "normal" in size. It is very loose knit - so it will snag if not super careful.  The buttons are cheesy looking plastic.  It feels like it is acrylic, however, with no labels of any kind, I really can't say.  I washed it on hand wash cycle and laid flat to dry just in case.  I will keep it because it was fairly inexpensive and the hassle of returning it would cost more than the sweater is worth both in terms of dollars and in terms of the hassle.  I would NOT order from this seller again.

Review: Title: Socks are rough on the interior and they slouch and move around in shoe Review: These socks are for a size 6-12.5. I take a 7.5 in men's and 9 to 9.5 in women's, so since these do not fit my boyfriend, I ordered them for me. I also usually go for a wide width in shoes for comfort and expect my socks to be roomy but still elasticized enough for snugness.

I really like the colors of these two pairs; however, that is where my like ends.  Unfortunately, I do not feel the same way about these socks as other reviewers.  I walked in them and find that the interior is not soft at all. It feels very rough on my feet; almost as if I am wearing a linen or burlap sock. 

These socks are also very thin and they do not stay up on the calf and tend to move around. After having tried these, these are only socks I can wear to bed or around the house. 

I wash them on cold and hang dry them.

In summary, these two pairs are very disappointing in the feel, thickness, and fit and I doubt it is because I am a woman wearing these and not a man.

Overall, I like these well enough. Just beware they will not last long. It also comes with one self-stick hook. The current price of $13.99 comes to an expensive $7 each. At my local store, I pay no more than $4 for an equivalent item.

UPDATE June 2, 2021 - I lowered my rating from 3 to 2 stars because the back brush came undone after about one month of use. I expect to get at least 4-6 months out of a back brush before I replace it and it did not last that long. See the photo.

Review: Title: Not for small faces
Review: [[VIDEOID:1ae6472135d5ca39a3b98e3e35afbe3f]] Cute fabric but the fit isn't great for small faces. (I'm 5'1, and have to buy "petite" glasses because regular glasses are too big for my face) Even if I tried to fold it up, it still hangs off the bottom of my face. The position of the ear strap folds my ear down a lot and is annoying. No way to reposition where it doesnt do that (I have had success repositioning other masks for a less bent ear). If i loosen it a lot for the ear, but then the fit in the face is even worse. I was hoping for a cute filter pocket mask with a good fit, as I've been able to find for my husband, and while I adore the fabric, the fit isn't what I was hoping for.

Review: Title: Great but...
Review: Good product, soft-sided with padding and I especially like the velcro on the handles so you're not fighting to grab both or risk dumping it if you grabbed one handle without zipping it shut. There's just one glaring exception and the reason for less than 5 stars - this is not truly big enough for a 13" laptop. I have the newest macbook air (about as slim as it gets) and yes it can slide into the case but you can't zip it shut (bag slightly too short) Then if you add anything to the inner pockets (such as cords!), you can't even get the laptop in the case at all. It does fit the larger 11" iPad with accessories, but seeing as that's not what I bought it for, I'm disappointed.

Review: Title: Nice speaker but better options out there
Review: This is a nice little boombox that’s great for low to mid level sound with decent bass. Also has a cool light and can be paired with other doss speakers for fuller/louder sound. My review is based on the one DOSS party boom speaker. It’s light weight which may save your arm but probably contributes to distortion if you try to crank the volume. My biggest grip is there is no battery level indicator. I have a ION block rocker that $20 more than this is currently selling for. It cam with a microphone and the sound is better cranked up. It also tells you how much battery is left. The only thing the DOSS has over the ION is the lights, weight it’s $20 cheaper. Do your research find out which one works best for you. If $20 is a too much and you need something lighter with cool lighting than this box may be for you.

These brushes comb through my hair easily. I had to assemble the detangling brush. This brush is perfect for combing wet hair in the shower. It glided through my hair. 

What I do not like about this set is the regular brush. It is very hard and almost rips at the hair. Also, it is irregular as can be seen in my photo. The brush lanes do not line up straight. 

At the current price of $10.44 ($10.99 minus 5%), this is somewhat pricey for the quality of this set. The detangler is good and typical but the regular brush is not good. The handles on both brushes are good, however, as they have a soft grip to them.

Review: Title: Antennas Direct Micron-R ClearStream Micron Indoor UHF DTV Antenna with Reflector Screen
Review: This product can work.My review is not to knock this product in a negative way but more to warn folks that if you do not live near the city (or where the TV towers are) then buy at your own risk.  I was really looking forward to cancelling my Comcast subscription so I purchased this antenna in lieu of a Comcast payment each month. I purchased the 35 mile radius as I live 25 miles from downtown Seattle. After installation and setup I received only 1 channel.  I have to admit the clarity of that one channel was fantastic however I do not speak Spanish so it was a let down. I believe this product works but not if you are on the outskirts of town. I would suggest only buying this if you live 20 miles or less away from city towers. Or if you live up on a hill that faces the city. Just my opinion for us more rural folks. I can tell (from the one channel I did get) that if I lived closer to the city this antenna would simply do the trick.  Hope this helps.

Review: Title: Long Term Life is Questionable; Seagate not good quality drives now
Review: The first one of these I got was DOA, but Seagate replaced it quickly for me at no charge, other than my cost to ship it back to them.  Seagate gives a 2-year warranty on their products and from what I understand that's because the expected life of their drives is only two years.  I have had too many failures with Seagate drives, although a drive from any manufacturer can fail and I have had other manufacturer's drives fail too.  I think my inclination now is not to buy Seagate any more.  There are better brands out there, but the bargain priced drives in any brand are usually the cheaper, less reliable ones.  You get what you pay for.  Just be aware that anything you put on a drive from ANY manufacturer should be regularly backed up in another location.  These days you probably want to buy 1TB and above anyway and not a 500GB, although it depends on how much storage you really think you might need.

Other than the dry cleaning recommendation, loose button threads, and the large space at the wrists, this is a very nice business-like shirt that is comfortable to wear.

Review: Title: You'll hate the product when you need to change the battery.
Review: Product does it's job, sometimes too well.  Rain will set it off, and so will rabbits and birds.  For this reason you may want to get a buried driveway probe otherwise you will get a lot of false alarms.  I have both this optical sensor and a probe and when I get dual notification, then I know something is out there.  Here's what needs to be improved:  #1  There are 4 Recessed screws to get to the battery, and when you flip it over so you can see where to put the battery they will fall into the dirt.  How Stupid of a design can you get!?!.  How about a simple battery compartment  access door or something that just snaps in place or a single screw.  #2  Who remembers obscure tones?  IF  you have multiple gates on your property, how are you going to remember which tone goes with what gate?  How about a voice over that says something like :  Area 1 or Area 2.  Or better yet, allow the user to upload or record their own tones or something:  "Someone at the Front Gate!"

Review: Title: They're okay
Review: I really wanted to like these jeans so although I bought three different style in one order and rated the other two as soon as I put them on, I waited with this one. I've worn them since and I still cannot fall in love. The wash is good, it's a dark denim which I wanted and expected. the fit is horrendous. The waist is high, higher than I measured, the material is very loose which although they have stretch should still mean that they fit, they don't. I am a size 12-14, I usually buy 14 in jeans if they have stretch but these are incredibly loose. The waist is loose and gape and although I like the length, the shape of the jeans make the bootcut very unattractive. I wanted to love them,  I really tried but because of the color and the fact that I can leave them for winter and through a sweat shirt over it with sneakers, I rated them a 3. Oh well, I still have two pairs I absolutely love!

Review: Title: The material is not as soft as I expected & this shirt really holds odor if one sweats Review: This is made in India of 95% Polyester and 5% Spandex. The feel of this shirt is not as soft as I expected. I have ordered other men's shirts that feel better than this. Also, I usually order a men's medium for a very snug fit as I usually wear these as undershirts. However, since this is an XXL, I can wear it as an outer shirt. I do feel it runs about a 1/2 size too small as I expected this to be very loose on me and it is just loose.

I cannot vouch for its sun protection; however, it works well as either an under or outer shirt for me. Nevertheless, it does stink easily if one sweats, especially in the armpits. I sweat a lot so I know even though I use the strongest deodorant with aluminum. My other shirts do not do this but this one does. It washes well in a lingerie bag and I hang dry it.

In summary, this is not a shirt I would order again. This is just okay.

Review: Title: JBL Balboa Sub10 is a worthy contender Review: Although the JBL Balboa Sub10 delivers very good performance for a relatively modest price, I would never refer to it as "the little subwoofer that could." That's because it's far from little; this thing is quite big by my standards. However, considering that the function of a subwoofer is to reproduce low-pitched audio frequencies, I'll accept that fact that it's the size it needs to be do its job well.

Because I live in a multi-family building and have neighbors with which I share walls, I have not been able to crank up the volume beyond medium. That being said, I have been quite pleased with the bass sound and have not experienced any distortion with this subwoofer at the volume range that I have used. Audiophiles who do not have cost as an object will no doubt want a more expensive subwoofer than the Sub10. However, for the rest of us who are just looking for a dependable, reasonably priced subwoofer for our sound systems, the JBL Balboa Sub10 is a worthy contender.

They have nice treds on the outside but it looks like they would wear down since they aren't that deep.
